values: 飞到半空连续发射剑气，最后一击造成额外伤害并将敌人击飞。
Dionel soars into the air and unleashes waves of spear thrust. The last hit deals extra damage and knocks the enemy into the air.
萨基塔里斯飞向半空，使自身无法被攻击，持续6秒。技能持续期间，自身的普通攻击变为向敌方最密集区域发射剑气，对半径一格范围内的所有敌人造成170% + 15% ATK点伤害。当发射最后一击时，伤害提高至250% ATK并击飞敌人。

Dionel soars into the air and becomes untargetable for 6s, during which he attacks the area with the most enemies using spear thrust, dealing 170% + 15% ATK damage to all adjacent enemies. The last hit of spear thrust knocks the enemy into the air, and its damage dealt is increased to 250% ATK.
本技能持续期间，萨基塔里斯获得技能“珍酿乐宴”的主动加成效果。如果自身已受该加成效果影响，则在本技能持续期间不消耗该加成效果的剩余时间，直至本技能结束。
Gains a Nectar Feast buff within the effect duration. Using this skill won't shorten its duration until the skill ends if Dionel has already been buffed.
剑气的伤害提升至180% + 15% ATK，最后一击的伤害提升至260% ATK。
Increases the damage of sword shock to 180% + 15% ATK and the damage of its last hit to 260% ATK.
本技能持续期间，若自身参与击败敌方英雄，则可使本技能的剩余持续时间延长2秒。每次释放本技能，最多只能触发1次该效果。
The skill duration is extended by 2s if Dionel achieves an assist or defeat on an enemy hero, triggered only once per casting.
剑气的伤害提升至190% + 15% ATK，最后一击的伤害提升至270% ATK。
Increases the damage of sword shock to 190% + 15% ATK and the damage of its last hit to 270% ATK.
自身的普通攻击距离提升，并能穿透敌人。
Increase the range of normal attacks and allow them to penetrate targets.
被动地，萨基塔里斯的普通攻击变为穿透攻击，对沿途所有敌人造成145% + 15% ATK伤害。
Passive. Dionel's normal attack turns into a Penetration attack, dealing 145% + 15% ATK damage to all enemies along the way.
穿透攻击的伤害提升至150% + 15% ATK。
Increases the Penetration attack damage to 150% + 15% ATK.
若当前所处的位置不佳，萨基塔里斯会在攻击间隙瞬移至一个更好的位置。该效果每6秒至多触发一次。
Flashes to a better attacking position if not in a good spot, triggered once every 6s.
穿透攻击的伤害提升至155% + 15% ATK。
Increases the Penetration attack damage to 155% + 15% ATK.
自身在获得友军增益效果时获得额外增益。主动使用时为自身提升攻击力和攻击速度。
Dionel gains extra buff when boosted by allied heroes and increase ATK and ATK SPD when actively used.
被动地，当自身获得一名友军施加的非永久属性提升效果时，将会积攒一层“沉醉”，使自身永久提高15%攻击力与15点攻击速度，该效果最多叠加3层，且通过每名友军最多只能触发一次。主动使用时，饮下神界佳酿，使自身提高20% + 2%攻击力与20 + 3点攻击速度，持续12秒。

Passive. Dionel gains a stack of Intoxication when receiving the non-permanent stats boost from an ally, increasing 15% ATK and 15 ATK SPD up to 3 stacks, triggered once only by each ally.
Active. Dionel drinks the divine nectar to increase 20% + 2% ATK and 20 + 3 ATK SPD for 12s.
每层“沉醉”提供的攻击力加成提升至16%，攻击速度加成提升至16。
For each Intoxication stack, the ATK bonus is increased to 16%, and the ATK SPD bonus is increased to 16.
每层“沉醉”提供的攻击力加成提升至18%，攻击速度加成提升至18。
For each Intoxication stack, the ATK bonus is increased to 18%, and the ATK SPD bonus is increased to 18.
主动使用时的加成效果提升至25% + 2%点攻击力与25 + 3点攻击速度。
The bonuses from active casting are increased to 25% + 2% ATK and 25 + 3 ATK SPD.
每次普通攻击后永久提升自身攻击速度。
Dionel's normal attack permanently increases his ATK SPD during battle.
每次普通攻击永久提升自身3点攻击速度，至多提升30点。
Dionel's normal attack permanently increases his ATK SPD by 3 during battle, for a maximum ATK SPD bonus of 30.
每次普通攻击永久提升自身4点攻击速度，至多提升40点。
Dionel's normal attack permanently increases his ATK SPD by 4 during battle, for a maximum ATK SPD bonus of 40.
每次普通攻击永久提升自身5点攻击速度，至多提升50点。
Dionel's normal attack permanently increases his ATK SPD by 5 during battle, for a maximum ATK SPD bonus of 50.
自身获得满层“沉醉”效果时方可使用，对所有敌人造成真实伤害。
Dionel deals true damage to all enemies. Only available when the owned Intoxication is fully stacked.
本技能仅在自身拥有的“沉醉”层数已叠加至满层时方可使用。短暂延迟后，召唤光枪从天而降，对场上所有敌人造成200% ATK真实伤害。本技能每场战斗最多释放3次。
Dionel summons a light spear after a short delay, dealing 200% ATK true damage to all enemies, up to 3 casting per battle. The skill is only available when the owned Intoxication is fully stacked.
本技能造成的伤害提升至210% ATK。
Increases the skill damage dealt to 210% ATK.
每场战斗首次释放本技能时，还会附带目标当前生命值20%的额外真实伤害，并会使目标在后续8秒内降低60点受愈。本技能附带的额外伤害最高不超过自身攻击力的1000%。

Deals extra true damage equal to 20% of the target's current HP when first casting the skill in a battle. Reduces target's Vitality by 60 in the next 8s. The extra damage is no more than 1000% of ATK.
本技能造成的伤害提升至220% ATK。
Increases the skill damage dealt to 220% ATK.
主动使用技能“珍酿乐宴”时，还会提高自身的终结。
Dionel increases Execution within the duration of Nectar Feast if it's been activated.
主动使用技能“珍酿乐宴”时，还会使自身在持续期间内提高20点终结。
Dionel increases Execution by 20 within the duration of Nectar Feast if it's been activated.
主动使用技能“珍酿乐宴“时，饮下佳酿的速度加快50%，且佳酿持续时间内获得可以抵御60% HP的护盾。此外，在叠加满层“沉醉”后，额外提升自身25点终结。

When Dionel casts Nectar Feast, he drinks the divine nectar 50% faster. While the divine nectar effect is active, he gains a shield that absorbs 60% HP damage. When he reaches max Intoxication stacks, his Execution increases by 25 further.
